WandaVoiceEnabled.description: Master switch for the WandaVoice extension.

WandaVoiceWakePhrase.description: Wake phrase that activates command capture while passively listening. Set to an empty string to disable wake phrase detection (push-to-talk only).

WandaVoiceWakeSensitivity.description: Fuzzy-matching sensitivity for wake phrase detection, between 0 (match anything vaguely similar) and 1 (exact match only).

WandaVoiceContinuousMode.description: Keep listening for the wake phrase after a command completes.

WandaVoiceLanguage.description: Primary BCP 47 language tag for speech recognition (e.g. "en-US"). Empty string uses the wiki content language.

WandaVoiceFallbackLanguages.description: Fallback language tags tried when the primary language is not supported by the browser speech engine (e.g. accent variants such as [ "en-GB", "en-AU" ]).

WandaVoiceRecognitionEngine.description: Speech recognition engine: 'auto' (browser-native when available, otherwise the server engine), 'browser' (Web Speech API only) or 'server' (MediaRecorder plus server-side transcription only).

WandaVoiceSTTEndpoint.description: Whisper-compatible speech-to-text endpoint (OpenAI audio/transcriptions contract) used by the server recognition engine, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions or a self-hosted LocalAI/faster-whisper URL. Empty disables the server engine.

WandaVoiceSTTApiKey.description: API key sent as a Bearer token to the speech-to-text endpoint. Leave empty for unauthenticated self-hosted servers.

WandaVoiceSTTModel.description: Model name passed to the speech-to-text endpoint.

WandaVoiceSTTTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for speech-to-text requests.

WandaVoiceMaxAudioSize.description: Maximum accepted audio upload size in bytes for the server recognition engine.

WandaVoiceUseLLM.description: Use Wanda's LLM for intent recognition of complex or compound commands. When false, only the built-in local command grammar is available.

WandaVoiceShowThinking.description: Show the command interpretation steps in the voice panel.

WandaVoiceAudioFeedback.description: Speak confirmations of completed actions using the browser speech synthesis engine.

WandaVoiceVisualIndicators.description: Show the visual status panel with recording indicators and transcripts.

WandaVoiceHapticFeedback.description: Vibrate on recording state transitions on devices that support it.

WandaVoiceNamespaces.description: Namespace IDs where the voice interface is available. An empty array enables it everywhere.

WandaVoiceMobileEnabled.description: Enable the voice interface in the mobile (MobileFrontend) view.

WandaVoiceCustomCommands.description: Map of custom spoken shortcut phrases to the command text they expand to, e.g. { "quick save": "save changes with summary minor edit" }.

WandaVoiceOfflineCommands.description: Commands guaranteed to be handled by the local grammar without contacting the LLM.
